description: A NetBox patch bump stays inside the plugin's supported minor, since
netbox-bgp declares a MAXIMUM NetBox of <minor>.x, so nothing needs to
move with it. Automerge is gated on the PR build in build.yml: that
runs collectstatic with the plugins enabled, so a pin that no longer
imports fails the check and the PR stays open. Note ignoreTests is
deliberately absent here -- the build must actually pass.
Merging only publishes an image; nothing deploys until the tag bump
is merged in the homelab repo, which stays manual on purpose.
A NetBox minor/major needs a netbox-bgp release that supports it, and
the plugin can lag by weeks: NetBox 4.7.0 shipped 2026-09-02 but
netbox-bgp 0.20.0 only on 2026-09-16. For that fortnight the upgrade
was impossible and an automerged base bump would have published an
image whose plugin was past its ceiling. Group the two into one PR and
never automerge, so the matrix gets read by a human:
